native_mechanisms: Eight violin strings bound under one bridge on the counting-bars: one pluck shivers into every other string, so all lanes co-mix — the mixing engine of the fold, with tremor carried across plucks so nothing settles between marks.
A fresh never-repeated inked feather per mark that records only the mark's weight (not its shape), binding strict position/order into the running count.

A single hands-off storm pass over the final tremor collapsing it into one small fixed token, after which the pickers destroy every discarded feather and ink drop (irreversibility, no intermediate state survives).
core_technique: xxHash3-style wide 8x64 striped accumulate (data ^= key; acc[i^1] += data; acc[i] += lo32*hi32) with AVX2 vectorization, a counter-stepped key sequence instead of a fixed secret, overlapping-read short-input paths, and an rrmxmx 64-bit finalizer.
